notes.title: Update: Gamepad Support & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We’re continuing to improve your gameplay experience!
This update introduces full gamepad support — now you can enjoy the game from the comfort of your couch with your favorite controller.
We’ve also fixed several minor bugs to make your journey smoother and more immersive.

🔧 What’s New:
• Full support for gamepads (Xbox, DualShock, and others)
• Control optimization
• Minor bug fixes and technical improvements

Thanks for staying with us — more updates are on the way!
